name: hive-site
//: hivefleet.dev - the public landing page for Hive and the door to the team sign-in. Next.js App Router + Tailwind v4, exported statically to out/ (the same toolchain as web/hub). Vercel builds and serves it (.github/workflows/deploy-site-vercel.yml); nothing here is embedded in the hive binary.

Sign-in: Clerk, through @clerk/clerk-react (client only: the export has no server, so no middleware and no server auth). The publishable key comes from NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY at build time (.env.example); without it the page builds and the sign-in says it is not set up yet. SignIn/SignUp use hash routing so /sign-in/ and /sign-up/ are plain static pages.
check: `npm run check` = typecheck (tsc --noEmit) + lint (eslint) + build + test.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test
